summary: LobeHub is a self-hosted AI chat framework designed to interface with multiple artificial intelligence providers. It includes features for an application marketplace and supports advanced text generation displays.
goodFor: Teams or individuals looking for a customisable, self-hosted web interface to interact with various generative AI APIs in one place.
watchOut: The software uses a proprietary licence, which may restrict how you can modify or redistribute the source code compared to standard open-source alternatives.
deployNotes: As a Node.js application packaged for Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for data storage and place it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
